queries_run: Quanta Services largest customer in-house self-perform utility insourcing 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：最大客戶占合併營收 8%、前十大客戶占 30%；公司稱客戶（主要為公用事業）有內部服務組織，目前仍外包大部分，但不保證未來不增加自製能力。
findings.excerpt: For the year ended December 31, 2025, our largest customer accounted for 8% of our consolidated revenues and our ten largest customers accounted for 30% of our consolidated revenues.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：客戶的內部服務組織可自行施作，客戶可能被迫增加自行施作而減少外包給 PWR；MSA 下客戶無義務指派特定工作量。未找到具體客戶已導入第二供應商或自製的新聞。
findings.excerpt: the in-house service organizations of our existing or prospective customers are capable of performing, or acquiring businesses that perform, the same types of services we provide, and these customers may also face pressure or be compelled by regulatory or other requirements to self-perform an increasing amount of the services we currently perform for them

customer_second_source.note: 搜尋未找到最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製的具體事件；僅有 10-K 一般性風險揭露。
